description.en: Sidebar button that checks whether DSH has a newer release and auto-downloads/opens the installer, with live progress, a minimizable panel, download mirrors for CN, and security checks (source confirm, private-IP block, SHA-256).
description.zh: 侧边栏按钮：检测 DSH 是否有新版本并自动下载/打开安装包。带实时进度、可最小化面板、国内镜像加速，以及下载安全校验（下载前来源确认、私网地址拦截、SHA-256 校验）。
